data_description.name: A friendly name for this todo list (e.g. Family Tasks).

error.already_configured: A Smart Todo list with this name already exists.

abort.already_configured: A Smart Todo list with this name is already configured.

create_task.name: Create task
create_task.description: Creates a new task in the Smart Todo list.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Marks a task as completed and triggers recurrence recalculation.

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Updates one or more fields of an existing task.

snooze_task.name: Snooze task
snooze_task.description: Snoozes a task until a specified date/time.

recalculate_recurrence.name: Recalculate recurrence
recalculate_recurrence.description: Recalculates due dates for recurring tasks.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: Optional. If omitted, recalculates all tasks.

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
get_tasks.description: Returns full task list with all fields as service response data.

overdue_only.name: Overdue only
overdue_only.description: If true, return only overdue tasks.

completed.name: Completed filter
completed.description: If true, include only completed. If false, exclude completed. If omitted, include all.
